$comment: Every release of every Eurth tool, for tools.eurth.org/changelog. Newest first. tool: the id in @eurth/style's tools.json. date: the Brussels day, YYYY-MM-DD; time (HH:MM) where it is known. Releases of one day are shown in this file's order, so keep the newest on top. title: sentence case, no full stop. notes: a sentence each. A release shows only once its tool has launched and its day has come, and is held back while it mentions a tool whose door is still closed, so entries can be written ahead. Please don't spoil the doors.

releases.title: Flagwright opens as a preview
notes: Simple mode makes a flag in four choices: 22 divisions, 16 overlays, 10 drawn symbols and 137 emblems.
Advanced mode places every layer by hand: up to 60 layers of 19 kinds, with guides and snapping.
A design check scores each flag out of ten against the principles of flag design, and spots lookalikes of some 30 real flags.
Download as SVG, PNG or WebP, copy the picture, the description or the link. The link holds the whole flag.
18 templates, a guide to the five principles and a glossary of 36 flag terms.

releases.title: A count of the countries minted
notes: The header counts the countries minted so far. A country counts when someone saves, copies, shares or exports it, once a visit; the page sends only "one more".

releases.title: Governmint works offline
notes: After the first visit a copy of the site stays on the device, so Governmint opens without signal, and a "No signal" note says so.
The light and dark switch grows its circle both ways.
The bottom bar's icons draw their outlines, then fill in, when pointed at.

releases.title: Pictures for stories without a photo
notes: Stories without a photo get a topic image, in link previews and in structured data.

releases.title: Structured data for every story
notes: Search engines can read the site's name and every story as a news article.

releases.title: A news sitemap
notes: A news sitemap, checked on every build, and a robots.txt.

releases.title: The Eurth coin as icon and logo
notes: The Eurth coin is the favicon and the app icon, with a web app manifest.
The coin replaces the turning globe as the logo in the header and as the way back to the top.

releases.title: Orioni mode moves to the footer
notes: Orioni mode is a button in the footer that works as a switch.
Periodical covers are shown uncropped and tilt when pointed at.

releases.title: Animated icons and footer columns
notes: Animated line icons, placeholder images, footer columns with periodicals and smooth scrolling.

releases.title: A disclaimer for borrowed images
notes: A disclaimer for images members take from other websites.

releases.title: Copyright and an automatic theme
notes: A copyright notice, a theme that follows the device, a clock with seconds, a search icon and footer links.

releases.title: The Eurth coin, and a stricter security policy
notes: The Eurth coin, with the yurt embossed, on the name card, in the bursts and on the sharing image.
A strict Content-Security-Policy and a Permissions-Policy.
A privacy line: no analytics, no trackers, no cookies, no data to sell.

releases.title: Budget locks and more exports
notes: Budget locks, with an angry slider when the locks leave no room, and wider treemap tiles.
The budget and the compass as Markdown, with a chart, and as JSON.

releases.title: An export panel and pictures of every chart
notes: An Export panel with JSON, and WebP and Copy image for every chart.
Toolbars for the budget and the compass.

releases.title: Sharing, and famous nations for the dice
notes: A sharing image for link previews, and a share window for the Eurth forum and nine other places.
Famous fictional nations for Random, and real countries recognised by name.

releases.title: Random, save, undo and redo
notes: Random, Save, Undo and Redo, real flags and keyboard shortcuts.
The budget's legend and treemap, sixteen new delights and a 404 page.

releases.title: Chart downloads and a budget pie
notes: Chart downloads, a budget pie, a compass that groups and enlarges, and search within the page.
Eurth blue, Wikipedia links, a one-sentence summary and small delights.

releases.title: Real countries, a spider chart and a compass
notes: 197 real countries and a picker, scales you can drag, a spider chart and a compass.
Markdown and wikitext exports, the Deluminator switch and the budget.

releases.title: Accessible in every look
notes: WCAG 2.2 AAA in every look and state, a light and dark switch, arrival animations and Orioni mode.

releases.title: Governmint opens as a preview
notes: Mint a government from its settings, with 18 examples, checks for contradictions and the whole design kept in the link.
Live at gov.eurth.org.

releases.title: A globe, a local clock and a section bar
notes: A globe, a clock in your own zone, a sticky section bar with search and a menu for phones.

releases.title: A front page for the Newsroom
notes: Headlines read from each post, a lead story and a grid, Most read, a filter by nation, search, a reader and a page for every story.
Link previews, and the look of the Eurth design system.

releases.title: The Newsroom opens
notes: A paper-style page and an RSS feed of the 25 newest stories from the Newsroom forum.

releases.title: The map opens
notes: The world of Eurth as a map you can zoom, with a minimap and distances measured in metres.
Layers for climate, ocean currents and tectonic plates.
